name: benchmark-nanofiqa
description: A benchmark/dataset for face image quality assessment (FIQA), measuring algorithms' ability to predict a numeric quality score that correlates with face recognition performance. Evaluations measure how well predicted quality ranks or predicts recognition utility (e.g., verification performance at various thresholds). It is intended for researchers developing quality estimation methods to improve biometric system robustness.
evaluation_method: correlation (Spearman / Pearson) between predicted quality and downstream recognition performance; sometimes AUC/verification metrics conditioned on quality bins
reputation: Recognized within the face biometrics community as a useful FIQA resource, though several competing FIQA datasets and protocols exist.
